speaker_title: Address by Mr. Gotabaya Rajapaksa, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Mr. Secretary-General,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. Secretary-General,

paragraphs.text: Your Majesties,
paragraphs.raw_text: Your Majesties,

paragraphs.text: Your Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Your Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: Distinguished Delegates,
paragraphs.raw_text: Distinguished Delegates,

paragraphs.text: Ladies and gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Ladies and gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: Ayubowan!
paragraphs.raw_text: Ayubowan!

paragraphs.text: At the outset, I congratulate Your Excellency Volkan Bozkir on being elected as the President of the 75th Session of the United Nations General Assembly. We wish you success and assure you of our fullest cooperation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the outset, I congratulate Your Excellency Volkan Bozkir on being elected 
as the President of the 75th Session of the United Nations General Assembly. We wish 
you success and assure you of our fullest cooperation.

paragraphs.text: I take this opportunity to extend our appreciation to His Excellency Prof. Tijani Muhammad-Bande, for his effective stewardship of the last General Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I take this opportunity to extend our appreciation to His Excellency Prof. 
Tijani Muhammad-Bande, for his effective stewardship of the last General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: I wish to extend Sri Lanka’s appreciation to the Secretary-General His Excellency António Guterres for his dynamic leadership and untiring efforts in pursuing the objectives of the United Nations, even amidst unprecedented conditions brought about by the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I wish to extend Sri Lanka’s appreciation to the Secretary-General His 
Excellency António Guterres for his dynamic leadership and untiring efforts in 
pursuing the objectives of the United Nations, even amidst unprecedented conditions 
brought about by the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: The effort taken to hold the UN General Assembly in a modified format, in keeping with the current constraints is commendable.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The effort taken to hold the UN General Assembly in a modified format, in 
keeping with the current constraints is commendable.

paragraphs.text: I extend my deepest condolences to all those who have lost loved ones due to the pandemic and express deep appreciation to the frontline healthcare and essential workers, both in Sri Lanka and globally, for their dedication and selfless commitment.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I extend my deepest condolences to all those who have lost loved ones due to 
the pandemic and express deep appreciation to the frontline healthcare and essential 
workers, both in Sri Lanka and globally, for their dedication and selfless commitment.

paragraphs.text: The theme of this year’s General Debate is timely, and echoes the importance of solidarity across national borders in alleviating the effects of COVID-19.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The theme of this year’s General Debate is timely, and echoes the importance 
of solidarity across national borders in alleviating the effects of COVID-19.

paragraphs.text: We commend the efforts taken by the UN to respond to this challenge, including the COVID 19 Global Humanitarian Response Plan and the establishment of the United Nations COVID-19 Response and Recovery Fund.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We commend the efforts taken by the UN to respond to this challenge, 
including the COVID 19 Global Humanitarian Response Plan and the establishment 
of the United Nations COVID-19 Response and Recovery Fund.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka supports the extensive work being carried out by the WHO, which has played a critical role in shaping the global response to the pandemic. The WHO now must seek to facilitate universal access to a COVID-19 vaccine, once developed, which should be designated as a basic public good and be affordable and obtainable by all.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka supports the extensive work being carried out by the WHO, which 
has played a critical role in shaping the global response to the pandemic. The WHO 
now must seek to facilitate universal access to a COVID-19 vaccine, once developed, 
which should be designated as a basic public good and be affordable and obtainable 
by all.

paragraphs.text: As a country proud of her long-standing democratic traditions, the Government of Sri Lanka has witnessed two free and fair elections, where I as the President and my Government were elected with overwhelming majorities.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a country proud of her long-standing democratic traditions, the Government 
of Sri Lanka has witnessed two free and fair elections, where I as the President and 
my Government were elected with overwhelming majorities.

paragraphs.text: The resounding mandates received at both the Presidential and Parliamentary elections have enabled the formation of a strong Government, dedicated to building a prosperous nation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The resounding mandates received at both the Presidential and Parliamentary 
elections have enabled the formation of a strong Government, dedicated to building 
a prosperous nation.

paragraphs.text: At a time when even the most powerful countries in the world were facing substantial challenges in the wake of COVID-19 pandemic, Sri Lanka was able to successfully face the challenge.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At a time when even the most powerful countries in the world were facing 
substantial challenges in the wake of COVID-19 pandemic, Sri Lanka was able to 
successfully face the challenge.

paragraphs.text: Thanks to a well-coordinated and synchronized mechanism of preventive measures at the national level, assisted by a robust local healthcare system, we managed to contain its spread. I must thank the people of my country for the cooperation they extended in this monumental task.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Thanks to a well-coordinated and synchronized mechanism of preventive 
measures at the national level, assisted by a robust local healthcare system, we 
managed to contain its spread. I must thank the people of my country for the 
cooperation they extended in this monumental task.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka’s sustenance during this calamity was due to the series of inclusive, non-discriminatory and holistic measures taken by the Government, prioritizing the health and safety of her people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka’s sustenance during this calamity was due to the series of inclusive, 
non-discriminatory and holistic measures taken by the Government, prioritizing the 
health and safety of her people.

paragraphs.text: These measures include, financially supporting low income families, pensioners, differently-abled, day-income earners, farmers, and disadvantaged groups and managing the repatriation of Sri Lankans in a coordinated manner.
paragraphs.raw_text:
These measures include, financially supporting low income families, 
pensioners, differently-abled, day-income earners, farmers, and disadvantaged 
groups and managing the repatriation of Sri Lankans in a coordinated manner.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka also explored avenues of business to create new economic trends. This included the use of digital technology to connect the farmer, supplier and consumer; to deliver essential items and services; and to provide on line education.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka also explored avenues of business to create new economic trends. 
This included the use of digital technology to connect the farmer, supplier and 
consumer; to deliver essential items and services; and to provide on line education.

paragraphs.text: These measures ensured the ‘right to life’ of all Sri Lankans and all foreign nationals who were trapped during restrictions on air travel, regardless of their ethnic, religious or social background.
paragraphs.raw_text:
These measures ensured the ‘right to life’ of all Sri Lankans and all foreign 
nationals who were trapped during restrictions on air travel, regardless of their 
ethnic, religious or social background.

paragraphs.text: The WHO has commended Sri Lanka’s efforts to control COVID-19 more effectively even with modest means, than more resourced countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The WHO has commended Sri Lanka’s efforts to control COVID-19 more 
effectively even with modest means, than more resourced countries.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka was among the first countries in South Asia to open schools to bring children back in safety, as commended by UNICEF. The World Travel and Tourism Council has recently stamped Sri Lanka as a safe destination for tourists.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka was among the first countries in South Asia to open schools to bring 
children back in safety, as commended by UNICEF. The World Travel and Tourism 
Council has recently stamped Sri Lanka as a safe destination for tourists.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka notes with deep concern that developing countries are facing an unprecedented economic and debt crisis due to the pandemic, and the need for debt relief and financial stimulus for such countries must be duly recognized.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka notes with deep concern that developing countries are facing an 
unprecedented economic and debt crisis due to the pandemic, and the need for debt 
relief and financial stimulus for such countries must be duly recognized.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka is committed to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
paragraphs.raw_text: Sri Lanka is committed to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

paragraphs.text: Moreover, we, as a country, are extremely serious about protecting our environment. With a bio-diversity that is unique to us, we are ensuring that our environmental assets are not only duly preserved but also prudently used. My government is taking all measures to strike the right balance between preserving the environment and taking development forward.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Moreover, we, as a country, are extremely serious about protecting our 
environment. With a bio-diversity that is unique to us, we are ensuring that our 
environmental assets are not only duly preserved but also prudently used. My 
government is taking all measures to strike the right balance between preserving the 
environment and taking development forward.

paragraphs.text: The recent debacle involving an oil tanker in our seas was carefully managed ensuring that our marine resources are in no way compromised. As a small country with limited resources to handle disasters of this magnitude, we, with the help of the neighbouring countries, minimized the damage caused by the oil tanker to the marine habitat.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The recent debacle involving an oil tanker in our seas was carefully managed 
ensuring that our marine resources are in no way compromised. As a small country 
with limited resources to handle disasters of this magnitude, we, with the help of 
the neighbouring countries, minimized the damage caused by the oil tanker to the 
marine habitat.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka welcomes the initiative of the President of the 74th General Assembly for launching the Alliance for Poverty Eradication, which will mobilize action on this issue.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka welcomes the initiative of the President of the 74th General Assembly 
for launching the Alliance for Poverty Eradication, which will mobilize action on 
this issue.

paragraphs.text: Based on the vision of my policy statement “Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour”, a Presidential Task Force in charge of Economic Revival and Poverty
paragraphs.raw_text:
Based on the vision of my policy statement “Vistas of Prosperity and 
Splendour”, a Presidential Task Force in charge of Economic Revival and Poverty

paragraphs.text: Eradication was established to create a production economy. The Task Force is focusing on creating a unique economic structure based on novel initiatives.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Eradication was established to create a production economy. The Task Force is 
focusing on creating a unique economic structure based on novel initiatives.

paragraphs.text: This complements my country’s long and consistent history of protecting our society from extreme poverty. Our government is taking a bold and creative initiative to reduce poverty in the country by targeting poor families and providing a member of each such family wage employment that will help the family to come out of poverty and look to the future with hope.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This complements my country’s long and consistent history of protecting our 
society from extreme poverty. Our government is taking a bold and creative initiative 
to reduce poverty in the country by targeting poor families and providing a member 
of each such family wage employment that will help the family to come out of poverty 
and look to the future with hope.

paragraphs.text: We are convinced that education is an important tool for emerging out of poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are convinced that education is an important tool for emerging out 
of poverty.

paragraphs.text: In Sri Lanka, the National Education System is being restructured according to the theme, “Equal learning opportunity for every child” envisaged in the national policy framework. Many rural schools are being upgraded and others modernized to equip children with knowledge and skills that would help them to contribute to the development of the country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In Sri Lanka, the National Education System is being restructured according 
to the theme, “Equal learning opportunity for every child” envisaged in the national 
policy framework. Many rural schools are being upgraded and others modernized to 
equip children with knowledge and skills that would help them to contribute to the 
development of the country.

paragraphs.text: A cost-free official “e-learning portal” for school children, with the support of all telecommunication operators, has successfully contributed towards home learning during the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A cost-free official “e-learning portal” for school children, with the support 
of all telecommunication operators, has successfully contributed towards home 
learning during the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: State Ministries have been established recently, covering all areas of education for women, children and youth of the country, placing emphasis on vocational and technical education and training.
paragraphs.raw_text:
State Ministries have been established recently, covering all areas of education 
for women, children and youth of the country, placing emphasis on vocational and 
technical education and training.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka remains deeply committed to addressing drug-related socio economic issues. There is a need to enhance efforts to strengthen the prevention of drug abuse among children and youth, and ensure that educational settings are free of any harmful and addictive drugs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka remains deeply committed to addressing drug-related socio 
economic issues. There is a need to enhance efforts to strengthen the prevention of 
drug abuse among children and youth, and ensure that educational settings are free 
of any harmful and addictive drugs.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka is extremely concerned about the increasing sophistication of the transnational criminal groups engaged in illicit manufacture and trafficking of drugs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka is extremely concerned about the increasing sophistication of the 
transnational criminal groups engaged in illicit manufacture and trafficking of drugs.

paragraphs.text: In order to address this, a Presidential Task Force was appointed to eradicate the drug menace, and to create a safer and a more secure country. Since its establishment, it has produced commendable results.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In order to address this, a Presidential Task Force was appointed to eradicate the 
drug menace, and to create a safer and a more secure country. Since its establishment, 
it has produced commendable results.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka, having experienced separatism and terrorism for near three decades, condemns all terrorist acts in the strongest possible terms, be it domestic or international.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka, having experienced separatism and terrorism for near three 
decades, condemns all terrorist acts in the strongest possible terms, be it domestic 
or international.

paragraphs.text: In spite of its elimination from the Sri Lankan soil, the international network of this terrorist outfit remains, pushing its ruthless ideology and influencing certain Capitals to spread its baseless lies and propaganda.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In spite of its elimination from the Sri Lankan soil, the international network 
of this terrorist outfit remains, pushing its ruthless ideology and influencing certain 
Capitals to spread its baseless lies and propaganda.

paragraphs.text: We are hopeful that no State will tolerate activities of this international network which continues to espouse and propagate violent ideology under different guises and manifestations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are hopeful that no State will tolerate activities of this international 
network which continues to espouse and propagate violent ideology under different 
guises and manifestations.

paragraphs.text: The global community must stand in solidarity with Sri Lanka, notwithstanding narrow domestic political compulsions, to counter terrorism. This ideology that introduced suicide bombings to the world has set precedents for acts of violent extremism across the world. This is evident by the growing recruitment drive of the extremist outfits.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The global community must stand in solidarity with Sri Lanka, notwithstanding 
narrow domestic political compulsions, to counter terrorism. This ideology that 
introduced suicide bombings to the world has set precedents for acts of violent 
extremism across the world. This is evident by the growing recruitment drive of the 
extremist outfits.

paragraphs.text: It is the hope of my people that the world community will not seek to forget or rewrite the violent past of this terrorist organization and allow the propagation of the group’s propaganda, which aimed at indoctrination and radicalization of another generation of youth.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is the hope of my people that the world community will not seek to forget 
or rewrite the violent past of this terrorist organization and allow the propagation of 
the group’s propaganda, which aimed at indoctrination and radicalization of another 
generation of youth.

paragraphs.text: As a nation that has witnessed the bitterness of war, Sri Lanka is committed to promoting peace across the world. We remain fully committed to UN Peacekeeping.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a nation that has witnessed the bitterness of war, Sri Lanka is committed to 
promoting peace across the world. We remain fully committed to UN Peacekeeping.

paragraphs.text: We are proud to have a long association with United Nations Peacekeeping Operations, with over 20,000 Sri Lankan Peacekeepers having served in UN Peace Missions across the world. They are providing critical services to conflict affected communities in most difficult and dangerous terrains.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are proud to have a long association with United Nations Peacekeeping 
Operations, with over 20,000 Sri Lankan Peacekeepers having served in UN Peace 
Missions across the world. They are providing critical services to conflict affected 
communities in most difficult and dangerous terrains.

paragraphs.text: As a Nation, we are keen to contribute to the common goal of global peace and security.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a Nation, we are keen to contribute to the common goal of global peace 
and security.

paragraphs.text: At a time when the United Nations reaches its 75th year, it is a great opportunity to self-assess the approach and success towards maintaining international peace, security and development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At a time when the United Nations reaches its 75th year, it is a great opportunity 
to self-assess the approach and success towards maintaining international peace, 
security and development.

paragraphs.text: The UN system needs to ensure equity, inclusivity and transparency, while being more responsive to the ever-changing global environment.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The UN system needs to ensure equity, inclusivity and transparency, while 
being more responsive to the ever-changing global environment.

paragraphs.text: In order to ensure the sustainability and the credibility of the Organization, political witch hunts through questionable motives against Member States, need to be halted.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In order to ensure the sustainability and the credibility of the Organization, 
political witch hunts through questionable motives against Member States, need to 
be halted.

paragraphs.text: Democratically elected governments of nations understand the pulse and needs of their people the best. It is the responsibility of the UN to assist and support processes of such elected Governments to bring about sustainable solutions for needs of their people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Democratically elected governments of nations understand the pulse and 
needs of their people the best. It is the responsibility of the UN to assist and support 
processes of such elected Governments to bring about sustainable solutions for needs 
of their people.

paragraphs.text: Sri Lanka is committed to follow a neutral foreign policy with no affiliations to any particular country or power bloc.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sri Lanka is committed to follow a neutral foreign policy with no affiliations 
to any particular country or power bloc.

paragraphs.text: As a strategically placed country in the Indian Ocean, it is our priority to ensure that the Indian Ocean is maintained as a zone of peace where no country could gain advantage over any other.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a strategically placed country in the Indian Ocean, it is our priority to 
ensure that the Indian Ocean is maintained as a zone of peace where no country could 
gain advantage over any other.

paragraphs.text: Moreover, the Indian Ocean has many international sea lanes that are economically important to a large number of nations and therefore, should remain accessible to global trade and commerce.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Moreover, the Indian Ocean has many international sea lanes that are 
economically important to a large number of nations and therefore, should remain 
accessible to global trade and commerce.

paragraphs.text: Geopolitically, too, the Indian Ocean receives the focus of the entire world. Given this situation, powerful countries and nations should provide their support and assistance to maintain the neutrality of the Indian Ocean and to protect its valuable marine resources.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Geopolitically, too, the Indian Ocean receives the focus of the entire world. 
Given this situation, powerful countries and nations should provide their support and 
assistance to maintain the neutrality of the Indian Ocean and to protect its valuable 
marine resources.

paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I wish to re-iterate the importance of the UN charter which enshrines the protection of sovereignty, territorial integrity of States and non-interference in their domestic affairs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In conclusion, I wish to re-iterate the importance of the UN charter 
which enshrines the protection of sovereignty, territorial integrity of States and 
non-interference in their domestic affairs.

paragraphs.text: Thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you.
